before.requirement: Use a nested object or array format to unpack a structure contained in an input value.
before.reason: The before source dispatches nested formats recursively. The harness supplies only o for object members and array elements; o extracts a pointer without recursive unpacking.

after.requirement: Use a nested object or array format to unpack a structure contained in an input value.
after.reason: Recursive dispatch remains available. The same fixed harness formats still select o for members and elements, so nested structures are returned without recursive unpacking.

claims.reason: Both versions support nested-format dispatch, and the same old harness lacks a nested member or element format on both sides.
